Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We understand that copper and other input costs are putting pressure on your pricing, and appreciate you setting out the cost drivers. Our order volume is fixed at our full demand for this part over the term, all with Nordmark, and our forecast is rising; could you review the offer with your pricing committee in light of this stable and growing business?

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 348.32 (po:4500014474-10, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014350-20).
Our forecast for this part is up 11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 351.23 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €373.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
For your information:
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We have reviewed your positive volume forecast and factored this growth into our calculation to offer a more favorable price.
To provide you with the most competitive rate, we must maintain our standard 30-day payment terms, as a 90-day term would necessitate a higher unit price.
Therefore, we propose a revised price of €369.76 per unit at 30 days net.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
We appreciate your movement in your latest reply and understand that a longer payment term would affect your pricing. Our order volume is fixed and represents our full demand for this part over the term, all placed with Nordmark; our forecast is rising, and our proposal moves toward you again. The proposal, including all terms, follows below.

On this basis we propose: EUR 368.27 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €371.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
For your information:
We acknowledge your revised proposal and your commitment to placing your full demand with Nordmark.
We cannot offer any further concessions while maintaining a 90-day payment term.
Therefore, we must hold our price at EUR 371.88 per unit, which constitutes our final offer.
Our pricing follows our approval process.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
